input.rationale: SOW Section 19 contains a genuine express performance warranty running in our favour: MSL warrants that all Products, supplied materials/Parts and work conform in all material respects to IBM-furnished specifications and are of specified quality, good workmanship and free from defect (p1059), with stated warranty periods for MSL Procured Parts (p1063) and workmanship (p1067) measured in months (figures redacted as [*]), commencing on delivery to IBM, surviving acceptance testing and expressly covering latent defects (p1068). The remedy set is at or above the preferred position: Failure Analysis, repair or replacement within a set turnaround, and a refund of MSL's price (plus Parts prices) where repair or replacement is not possible (p1077), supplemented by MSL bearing Product Recall costs on epidemic failure (p1086) and a clean-title warranty (p1075). The Section 19.6 "in lieu of" language (p1079/p1083) disclaims only implied/other terms and is expressly framed as replacing them with "MSL'S WARRANTY OBLIGATIONS DESCRIBED IN THIS SECTION 19" — it does not swallow the express warranty, so this is nowhere near the "AS IS" walk-away. Minor sub-elements short of the model wording are noted only: there is no express "no malicious code" warranty and no standalone conformance-to-documentation software warranty (compliance with law is handled separately at Section 16.4), and the warranty durations are redacted; these are not material failures of the fallback and we do not redline them.
